question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Your silly tricks will not __impress__ me.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impact**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"impress"** means to make someone feel admiration and respect, or to influence a person's thoughts, feelings, or actions. (प्रभावित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **He tried to impress his boss with his dedication and hard work.
 
 
 
• **"Impact"** refers to having a strong effect or influence on someone or something. (प्रभाव)
 
 
• **Example: **The new policy will have a significant impact on the company's revenue.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Impact**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Expunge** (हटाना): To remove or erase something completely.

 
 
• **Example:** The criminal record was expunged after the evidence proved his innocence.
 
 
 
• **Bore** (उबाना): To make someone feel uninterested or tired.
 
 
• **Example: **His long speech started to bore the audience.
 
 
 
• **Neglect** (उपेक्षा): To fail to care for or give attention to something or someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The garden was neglected and overgrown with weeds.
 
 

Question: Your silly tricks will not impress me.

The correct answer is: **Impact**.
